prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story / precise-object-edit. Create a full opaque 16:9 horizontal background illustration for the contemporary Chinese woodcraft game 榫间, no UI or captions. Input 1 is the existing workshop painting and Lin Lan identity/camera/style reference. Input 2 is the APPROVED ACTUAL 3D furniture design reference ONLY: draw this exact assembled shoe-changing stool as part of the 2D illustration, never paste in the 3D screenshot, and remove all screenshot UI. Keep the existing workshop architecture, windows, left-positioned young woman in olive green shirt and navy work apron holding a notebook, warm afternoon sunlight, ink outlines and natural anime proportions. On the foreground table at center-right place the finished small stool, physically plausible 45cm high: dark walnut two end trestle leg frames with low crossbars, light pale broad rectangular sliding seat with thick edge/skirt, exactly two warm wood square-headed locking pegs on the visible long edge near opposite ends. Follow the reference model's silhouette/contact relationship, proportions and two-tone wood. The illustrated stool must share the table perspective, outline treatment, warm left window light and a grounded contact shadow; it is a drawn object in this picture, not a floating 3D object. Keep the tray at left, notebook at right, tools in back. Natural hands and face. Composition: full room remains visible, main object center-right in middle/lower portion, left upper and bottom 15 percent relatively quiet for game UI. The picture must be wide landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080; do not crop off the furniture or heads. Clean hard-edged anime game background with modest painted grain, not photorealism, no gold decorations, no text, no logo.

stateMeanings.workshop-loose: 备赛未完成：框架固定，宽主板和两销独立放在保护布上。
stateMeanings.workshop: 备赛完成：主板与两销归位。
stateMeanings.contest: 运输后/拆修后：三件放在保护布上，框架保持。
stateMeanings.contest-built: 正式装配或维修复装完成：全部归位，保护布为空。
stateMeanings.after: 获奖后：小许试坐/放书杯/放书，周伯观展。

limitations: These are fixed painted milestone states, not every intermediate one-pin state; the puzzle engine and progress label provide exact partial state.
Generated local edits preserve overall framing and identity but are not guaranteed pixel-identical outside the changed region.
No UI/layout/browser QA performed by this asset agent; parent owns runtime checks.
